caption:
Preseason court training is back and Lulu's legs feel like lead. Netball and basketball mean jumping, landing, sprinting and sudden stops, so tight calves and heavy quads are common early on.

Remedial massage can ease that heavy feeling and help you move more comfortably. Timing matters: lighter work a day or two before games, firmer sessions after games or on light training days. It complements landing practice, calf and hip strength, and sensible training load rather than replacing them.

A rolled ankle, a knee that gives way or swelling that won't settle needs an assessment first. Our team at Hybrid Physio refers between massage and physio when needed. Book online via the link in bio 🏀

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
